results.basis: Current fact knownBy Acts 13:2 says only that the Holy Spirit directed that Barnabas and Saul be set apart for the called work, with sources web-act-13-1 and web-act-13-2. It no longer says that they were sent or traveled. A separate fact knownBy Acts 13:4 says that after fasting/prayer and laying on hands they were sent, then went to Seleucia and sailed to Cyprus; its sources web-act-13-3 and web-act-13-4. The pinned WEB witness says 13:2 “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them”; 13:3 reports fasting, prayer, laying hands and sending; 13:4 reports the Holy Spirit sending them to Seleucia and sailing to Cyprus. Thus each fact is gated no earlier than its latest asserted event, and the former 13:2 future spill is resolved.
